articles.title: $4.2B crypto bank Anchorage Digital cuts 17% of workforce: Report
articles.snippet: The reported cuts come as Anchorage expands its institutional footprint, including stablecoin issuance and a $100 million investment from Tether.

articles.title: ‘Euro stablecoin isn’t enough’: EU issuers make case for USD tokens
articles.snippet: European issuers say Europe cannot ignore demand for dollar stablecoins as businesses seek USD liquidity for global payments and settlement.

articles.title: Circle urges EU to revise stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review
articles.snippet: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.

articles.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
articles.snippet: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.
